description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for handling 'terms' related web requests, including listing and showing individual terms, with navigation to previous and next terms.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Terms
classes.description: Controller class for handling 'terms' related web actions in a Catalyst application.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list terms, redirects to the 'show' page of the current valid term.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to display a specific term, including navigation to previous and next terms.
